rows.story_prompt: A kitchen story with persistent object state.
shot_prompts: Alex opens the red jar on the counter.
The jar lid stays off beside the jar on the counter.
Alex pours sugar from the open jar into a bowl.
The open jar remains on the counter without its lid.
Alex wipes the counter beside the still-open jar.
Mira lifts the brass lamp from the suitcase.
Mira places the lamp on the bench in the same room.
The lamp stays lit on the bench.
Mira closes the suitcase while the lamp remains lit.
Mira walks away leaving the lit lamp on the bench.
